sections.Intro: This remedy is especially indicated in cases of extreme debility and lack of vital force, particularly in women. It is useful in cases of anaemia and digestive disorders. There is a general feeling of weariness and exhaustion. It is often called 'the china of the uterine organs.'
sections.Mind: Confused and forgetful. Depression and anxiety.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Nausea. Disgust for food. Heaviness in the stomach.
sections.Abdomen: Distended with gas. Flatulence. Chronic constipation.
sections.Female: Uterine debility. Leucorrhoea. Prolapse of the uterus. Habitual miscarriage.
